steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8095/ and sign in with username admin and password typed exactly as the text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type that literal text into the password field; it gets filled in automatically - do not guess or spell out any password). After signing in, navigate to the repository bench/bench-repo and open its Issues list. Report: (a) the exact titles of all OPEN issues, especially any whose title starts with 'Seed:', and (b) whether an issue titled '{{runid}} Bench Issue' already exists, and if so its issue number as displayed (e.g. #123).

02-create: In the repository bench/bench-repo on Gitea, create a NEW issue with title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Issue' and a description (markdown text area) that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench issue created for run {{runid}}'). Submit it. Then report the issue number exactly as the app displays it (Gitea shows it as #<number>) and the URL of the new issue page. Do not modify any of the existing 'Seed:' issues.

03-open: On the Gitea issue page {{02-create.url}} (issue '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), use the sidebar pickers to configure the issue so that: (1) it has exactly the two labels 'bug' and 'priority-high' (and {{01-open.bench_issue_exists}} other labels), (2) it is assigned to the user 'bench-assignee', and (3) its milestone is 'Bench Milestone'. Each picker choice must be actually applied and shown on the issue page (not merely ticked in an open menu) - close/confirm each picker and verify the sidebar shows the applied label chips, the assignee name, and the milestone. Report exactly what the sidebar shows afterwards for labels, assignee, and milestone.

04-add: On the Gitea issue page {{02-create.url}} (issue '{{runid}} Bench Issue'), add a comment using the markdown comment text area at the bottom of the page. The comment text must include '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment added for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment and verify it appears on the issue page. Report the exact text of the comment as displayed after posting.

05-open: Open {{02-create.url}} and verify the full state of this issue, reporting each of these facts exactly as displayed on the page: (1) the issue title and its number as displayed (e.g. {{02-create.issue_number_displayed}}), (2) the full rendered description text, (3) the exact list of labels shown in the sidebar (list every label chip, confirm there are {{01-open.bench_issue_exists}} others), (4) the assignee(s) shown, (5) the milestone shown, (6) the text of every comment on the issue. Also open the repository's open issues list at http://127.0.0.1:8095/bench/bench-repo/issues and report the exact titles of all open issues. Do not change anything - this is read-only verification.
